11.label: The Jinyu Waterforging Courtyard
availability: Available at a craft courtyard, workshop or quay with a controlled clean-water supply. An actual trained watersmith and controlled usable water are required; culture ancestry alone does not create the skill.
art: Paint a functioning Warcraft waterforging courtyard in a wide 16:9 view. The original local workshop surrounds a series of low polished basins and precise stone channels. A controlled ribbon of water curls around a metal workpiece, its surface becoming smooth and seamless under the watersmith’s craft. Unfinished river stones, refined plates, pressure vessels and neatly arranged tools make the process intelligible. Reflected blue light travels across wet gray stone, while warm lamps reveal a dry visitor path and waiting bench. Use elegant flowing lines and disciplined placement rather than roaring flames, industrial goblin machinery or a divination shrine. Ordinary minor water-working magic may operate here; the scene should present a skilled workshop, not a miraculous world-scale fountain.
contexts: Water runs with an oddly measured rhythm through the channels. On the working stand, a metal plate turns slowly beneath a narrow current, losing its rough seams a little at a time. Finished pieces feel almost grown rather than hammered. Customers wait on the dry side of the court while the watersmith checks a workpiece, rejects an impure blank or names the time a repair will take. A commission can carry more than a price: a damaged weapon, an unfamiliar ore or a disputed family heirloom brings its story to the basin. Conversation follows the pauses in the water’s patient work.
hybrid: Match native jinyu or jinyu ancestry together with a retained/adopted waterforging capability; an unrelated culture may learn it explicitly. Ankoan membership or generic Sorcerous Metallurgy alone does not prove jinyu waterforging. Keep practitioners and water supply as real capability conditions. Students and customers use dry paths; practitioners can belong to any local ancestry if actually trained in waterforging.

extrapolation: A small portable watersmith workshop fitted into local architecture.

art: Illustrate a Warcraft learned gallery in a wide 16:9 frame. An ordinary local stone or timber room holds a distinct Nerubian installation: angular reading stalls, insect-leg-shaped metal braces, geometric screens and shelves of books, tablets and tightly bound records. A long central table has several equal speaking positions and portable lamps casting cool blue-violet pools of light. Gold and turquoise accents pick out the joints rather than flooding the walls with ornament. Leave a clear floor-level entrance and the original building’s shape readable. The atmosphere is exacting and inhabited, with opened manuscripts, small musical resonators and corrected diagrams suggesting ongoing intellectual life. Visitors can consult a chronicle, challenge an interpretation, seek a translator or commission an account that others would prefer forgotten. The gallery offers a measured civic stage where knowledge conveys standing, and where choosing which evidence to preserve can become a political act.

11.label: The Qiraji Caste Muster Court
availability: Available at a garrison court, military camp or guarded settlement receiving yard.
art: Render an imposing Qiraji muster court in a wide painterly Warcraft view. Preserve the local courtyard or military camp underneath portable black angular screens and towering gold-turquoise standards. Weapon racks, sharply separated waiting bays and a modest command platform make the space read as an organized hierarchy. Curved chitin-like trim contrasts with flat heavy stone or painted timber panels; geometric markings repeat across shields and equipment crates. Harsh sunlight or strong local lamps cast crisp divisions across the ground. Keep a deliberate visitor approach clearly visible beside the muster lines. The scene conveys imperial insectoid severity through materials and spatial ordering, without copying Ahn’Qiraj’s unique gates, installing C’Thun’s eye altar or conjuring an attendant silithid brood.
contexts: Different ranks wait in different bays, and the arrangement is obvious long before anyone explains it. Spears stand in repeated lines beneath heavy standards; orders travel from the raised speaking place into the groups below with little wasted movement. A visitor is received through a designated approach, where credentials and purpose determine how far the conversation advances. Supplies, military service, a contested command or a prisoner’s transfer can all be negotiated here. The court turns hierarchy into visible space, making an unexpected crossing, an empty rank position or a deliberately misplaced standard an event everyone can understand.

Nerubian or Mantid Aqir heritage alone is insufficient. Paths and equipment match the actual community; caste-role presentation can persist in mixed culture without creating insect bodies or silithid laborers.

11.label: The Kobold Wax-and-Scrap Alcove
availability: Available at a working mine passage, quarry shelter, cellar workshop or settlement salvage corner.
art: Paint a lively Warcraft work alcove in wide 16:9. Old local mine supports or cellar beams remain beneath a dense kobold arrangement of wax pots, wick bundles, candle molds and patched digging tools. Fresh candles cool on uneven racks; a low lamp lights scrap sorted into purposeful little heaps. Bent nails, handles, ore fragments and repaired buckets crowd the shelves, with string rattles and marked supply cubbies at the edge. Make the working light abundant but uneven, throwing warm gold onto rough stone and grubby timber. Leave a clear visitor patch outside the active wax bench. This is practical candle making and salvage, visibly useful and fiercely minded, without a divine candle shrine or an imposed subterranean darkness monster.
contexts: Warm wax and damp earth scent the alcove. A mold is tapped against the bench, a wick is trimmed, and some scrap that looked worthless finds a place on a repaired tool. The supply cubbies are watched closely; taking a candle or a length of wire without asking can matter more than a polished title. Visitors can trade useful rubbish, buy working light, ask about a newly opened passage or bring an object that someone here knows how to mend. Between the patched tools and carefully saved fragments, the alcove rewards practical usefulness more quickly than grand promises.
hybrid: Use the live county culture, not the ruler or resident race. A hybrid with native kobold ancestry may retain this ordinary community practice and its portable styling; no separate institution flag is required for the modest venue. An unrelated culture needs deliberate adoption of this catalog practice. Use the accessible adaptation for the actual local residents. Raise benches, widen the entry and keep head clearance for larger converts; the work pattern survives without making residents kobold-sized.
lore: Candle making, wax harvesting and scavenging are documented kobold work; native Ancient Miners and Battlefield Looters fit the practical setting.
extrapolation: A non-sacred maintenance venue distinct from Candlism’s protective altar.

11.label: The Snobold Hunt-Relay Shelter

art: Create a practical Warcraft hunting shelter in a wide 16:9 view. The local campsite or rock recess stays intact beneath tightly lashed hide screens and a profusion of portable bundles. Bone hooks, patched spears, small cooking gear and sorted food bags occupy every sheltered edge. A relay bench has room to set down a fresh load beside a half-mended pack; brightly tied markers make individual bundles identifiable. Wind or local dust presses against the screens while a small sheltered fire casts amber light under the canopy. Convey alert, adaptable camp service rather than a ceremonial lodge. Equipment sizes follow the actual occupants, and the background carries the region’s own climate; a magnataur silhouette is reserved for a real herd-supported variant.
contexts: Bundles are opened, checked and closed again with practiced speed. A hunter’s return sets the whole shelter moving: food is divided, damaged straps reach the repair bench and the next party learns which route proved useful. Visitors can exchange news, ask to follow a trail or discover that the provisions they expected have already been promised elsewhere. The shelter’s value lies in making a traveling group function, and a missing bag or delayed messenger can upset everyone’s plans. Its patched screens give enough cover for a quick negotiation while the camp’s ordinary work continues around the speakers.

11.label: The Forsaken Field Dispensary
availability: Available at an ordinary settlement clinic, apothecary stall or traveling medical shelter. An actual apothecary or learned practitioner with supplies; choose treatments for actual resident bodies.
art: Paint a functioning Warcraft apothecary counter in a wide 16:9 interior. The host cottage or tent remains recognizable behind crooked dark-iron brackets, pointed cabinet trim and purple-green bottles. Glass retorts, prepared herb drawers, bandages and durable medical tools occupy the screened work bench; a lower clear counter receives visitors. Green reagent light contrasts with a warm practical lamp rather than filling the room with poisonous fog. Add patched Lordaeron-style timber details, a worn leather field kit and carefully separated supplies for different treatments. The space should feel dour, ingenious, medical and slightly unsettling, with visible working alchemy at an ordinary scale. Avoid a cult pulpit, experimental victim, compulsory plague weapon or royal organization emblem.
contexts: A stopper clicks into place behind the screen, followed by the dry rasp of a mortar. The counter smells of bitter herbs and sharp preservative, and the apothecary’s questions are practical before they are comforting. Patients arrive with wounds, failing remedies and conditions that ordinary village medicine may not understand. A messenger can request a field kit, a family can argue over payment or a supplier can be asked why an expected ingredient never arrived. The dispensary makes room for difficult bodies and difficult histories; an accurate account of what happened often matters more than the patient’s rank.
hybrid: Match forsaken ancestry retaining/adopting field apothecary practice. Active Medicinal Plants is useful current support, but generic Medicinal Plants alone does not impose Forsaken gothic styling. A modest inherited dispensary needs no separate political-organization flag. Serve the actual mixture of living and undead patients with appropriate treatments; undeath, necromancy and disease weapons are not automatic.
lore: Forsaken field apothecaries and alchemical centers are documented; native Medicinal Plants supports practical local medical craft.
extrapolation: A small dispensary with mixed-body care, separate from faith-conditioned alchemical proof/sacrifice and Forsaken Cult chapter audiences.

availability: Available at an existing inn, public house or settlement common room.
art: Illustrate a inhabited Forsaken public house in wide 16:9 Warcraft style. The local inn’s walls remain visible around salvaged dark-wood furniture, hooked iron lamps and green glass that gives the shadows a bruised glow. A repaired meal and drink counter faces mixed sturdy seating; patched upholstery and recognizable domestic pieces keep the place socially warm beneath its gothic severity. Shelves hold mundane keepsakes, old keys, chipped crockery and repaired portrait frames rather than sacred relics. A door opens toward the ordinary settlement outside, and a quiet side table permits a difficult conversation. Convey continuity after upheaval through careful repairs and stubborn everyday use. The room is neither an abandoned tomb nor a compulsory scene of despair, with no named ruler or cult symbol required.
contexts: The counter is worn smooth where patrons still lean on it, and a repaired portrait frame sits above a shelf of things someone refused to throw away. Drinks, meals and company bring different customers to the same room. Old names sometimes survive in conversation after the places they belonged to have changed. A visitor can seek lodging, hire a guide, meet an estranged acquaintance or learn why a seemingly ordinary keepsake attracts a dispute. Humor here can have a sharp edge, but the inn’s simple routines make space for friendship, suspicion and business without requiring anyone to explain their whole history.

art: Paint a seductive Warcraft reception parlour in a wide 16:9 composition. Preserve the local inn or residence under lavish portable violet curtains, dark red upholstery and slender horn-curved furniture. Low amber lamps and cool purple reflections leave a clear but alluring path from the entrance to arranged conversation seats. Perfume vessels, polished cups, musical instruments and a small refreshment tray imply active hospitality rather than an empty boudoir. Screens create intimate alcoves while mirrors make the room feel watchful. Convey confidence, theatrical pleasure and dangerous social finesse through rich texture and deliberate placement. 11.label: The Nathrezim Sealed Record-House
availability: Available at an archive corner, diplomatic office, guarded study or records suite.
art: Render a sinister cultivated Warcraft record-house in wide 16:9. The original study is enclosed by removable blackwood screens and narrow dark-metal cabinet ranks, recalling windowless Nathrezim archives at room scale. A public desk faces the entrance; behind it, sealed cases, cipher sheets, map folios and restrained lamps disappear into deep blue-black shadow. Angular batlike curves ornament the cabinet fittings without a god’s image. One carefully lit table shows a document being copied, another holds a series of unopened packets. Preserve ordinary local walls above the screens and a clear visitor route. The room should communicate patient intelligence, secrecy and organized political memory through working records, not a compulsory hidden patron, active mind control or a revelation of cosmic canon.
contexts: The lamps illuminate the reading surfaces precisely and leave the cabinets beyond them obscure. A packet is weighed in the hand before its seal is checked; an ordinary name can send a clerk to a drawer far from the public desk. Visitors submit reports, request an introduction, dispute a recorded obligation or ask for information whose price is unlikely to be simple coin. The room keeps its power in what it remembers and how selectively that memory is shared. A missing copy, an altered line or a seal found on the wrong correspondence can matter more here than a shouted threat.
hybrid: Use the live county culture, not the ruler or resident race.
